role.en: Founding Chairman, IDEA; Council Chairman, HKUST
role.zh: IDEA 研究院创始理事长；香港科技大学校董会主席

why.en: Former Microsoft EVP and one of the founders of Microsoft Research Asia — which directly trained the first generation of leaders across China's AI industry.
why.zh: 前微软全球执行副总裁，微软亚洲研究院的奠基者之一，直接培养了中国 AI 产业的第一批领军人物。

title.en: IDEA Research — open models and the AIGC programme
title.zh: IDEA 研究院 —— 开源模型与 AIGC 方向

title.en: When doing large scale software engineering using LLM, which is better, @OpenAI Codex5.3 or @AnthropicAI Opus4.6? Check out a fair comparison at https://t.co/kR
title.zh: When doing large scale software engineering using LLM, which is better, @OpenAI Codex5.3 or @AnthropicAI Opus4.6? Check out a fair comparison at https://t.co/kR

note.en: Shum shared a head-to-head test of OpenAI's Codex 5.3 against Anthropic's Opus 4.6 on large-scale software engineering, run through the MoonBit language.
note.zh: 沈向洋分享了一项对比测试，用MoonBit语言评测OpenAI Codex 5.3与Anthropic Opus 4.6在大规模软件工程任务上的表现。

title.en: https://t.co/QrWwA35t76 - Performance of Step1X-Edit approaches that of GPT4o and Gemini Flash - Consistency of Step1X-Edit is impressive
title.zh: https://t.co/QrWwA35t76 - Performance of Step1X-Edit approaches that of GPT4o and Gemini Flash - Consistency of Step1X-Edit is impressive

note.en: Shum noted that Step1X-Edit's image-editing performance approaches GPT-4o and Gemini Flash, calling its consistency impressive.
note.zh: 沈向洋指出Step1X-Edit的图像编辑效果已接近GPT-4o和Gemini Flash，并称赞其一致性令人印象深刻。

title.en: 沈向洋：中国备案行业大模型数量占比约70%，未来数量将更多
title.zh: 沈向洋：中国备案行业大模型数量占比约70%，未来数量将更多

note.en: He states that roughly 70% of China's registered industry-specific large models are officially filed with regulators, and expects the number to keep growing.
note.zh: 他表示中国已备案的行业大模型数量占比约70%，并预计这一数字未来还将继续增长。

title.en: Too many objects, so little time: Open set object detection work by my colleagues and students 10 FPS (640x640) on NVIDIA Orin NX
title.zh: Too many objects, so little time: Open set object detection work by my colleagues and students 10 FPS (640x640) on NVIDIA Orin NX

note.en: Shum highlighted open-set object detection work from his colleagues and students running at 10 FPS on an NVIDIA Orin NX.
note.zh: 沈向洋介绍了其同事与学生的开放集目标检测研究成果，可在NVIDIA Orin NX上实现10 FPS的运行速度。

title.en: Check out Grounded-Segment-Anything by my students and colleagues: automatically Detect, Segment and Generate anything with image and text Inputs. Edge segmenta
title.zh: Check out Grounded-Segment-Anything by my students and colleagues: automatically Detect, Segment and Generate anything with image and text Inputs. Edge segmenta

note.en: Shum promoted Grounded-Segment-Anything, a project from his students and colleagues combining detection, segmentation and text-driven generation.
note.zh: 沈向洋推介了其学生与同事的Grounded-Segment-Anything项目，可结合检测、分割与文本驱动生成。

title.en: Creating Virtual AI Beings
title.zh: Creating Virtual AI Beings

note.en: Shum co-authored a paper on building virtual AI beings, drawing on his computer vision and graphics background.
note.zh: 沈向洋合著了一篇关于打造虚拟AI角色的论文，延续了他在计算机视觉与图形学领域的研究。

title.en: Data-Driven Learning for Data Rights, Data Pricing, and Privacy Computing
title.zh: Data-Driven Learning for Data Rights, Data Pricing, and Privacy Computing

note.en: Shum co-authored a paper on data-driven approaches to data rights, pricing and privacy-preserving computation.
note.zh: 沈向洋合著了一篇论文，探讨数据确权、数据定价与隐私计算的数据驱动方法。

title.en: We are now at a much better place than people like Wiener and Shannon seventy years ago when it comes to uncovering, understanding, and even exploiting Intellig
title.zh: We are now at a much better place than people like Wiener and Shannon seventy years ago when it comes to uncovering, understanding, and even exploiting Intellig

note.en: Shum argued that today's tools put us in a far better position than Wiener and Shannon were, seventy years ago, to uncover and exploit intelligence.
note.zh: 沈向洋认为，相比七十年前的维纳和香农，如今我们在揭示、理解乃至运用智能方面已处于更有利的位置。

title.en: Construction of panoramic mosaics with global and local alignment
title.zh: Construction of panoramic mosaics with global and local alignment

note.en: Shum and Szeliski's paper on building panoramic image mosaics with global and local alignment, a foundational technique in computational photography.
note.zh: 沈向洋与Szeliski合著的论文，提出结合全局与局部对齐构建全景图像拼接的方法，是计算摄影学的奠基性工作之一。

title.en: About a year ago, I had a real-time conversation with Brian Trager, a professor at the @RITNTID. That might not sound like a big deal until you learn that Brian
title.zh: About a year ago, I had a real-time conversation with Brian Trager, a professor at the @RITNTID. That might not sound like a big deal until you learn that Brian

note.en: Shum recounted holding a real-time conversation in Chinese with a deaf RIT/NTID professor, illustrating accessible speech technology in practice.
note.zh: 沈向洋讲述了自己与罗切斯特理工学院聋人教授通过技术进行中文实时对话的经历，展现了无障碍语音技术的实际应用。

title.en: Excited about InterpretML - a great open-source resource for developers to experiment with intelligible #AI! https://t.co/tqUG1qE6TO
title.zh: Excited about InterpretML - a great open-source resource for developers to experiment with intelligible #AI! https://t.co/tqUG1qE6TO

note.en: Shum promoted InterpretML, an open-source toolkit for building and experimenting with interpretable AI models.
note.zh: 沈向洋推介了开源工具包InterpretML，供开发者构建和实验可解释AI模型。

title.en: The Design and Implementation of XiaoIce, an Empathetic Social Chatbot
title.zh: The Design and Implementation of XiaoIce, an Empathetic Social Chatbot

note.en: The system paper for Microsoft XiaoIce, co-authored while he led the effort as EVP, laying out the empathetic-computing design behind the chatbot.
note.zh: 微软小冰的系统论文，由他以执行副总裁身份主导该项目期间合著，阐述了小冰背后的移情计算设计。

title.en: From Search to Research
title.zh: From Search to Research

note.en: Shum wrote a piece on the shift from web search to research-driven AI, reflecting on his time leading Bing and Microsoft Research Asia.
note.zh: 沈向洋撰写的文章，探讨从网络搜索走向研究驱动型AI的转变，回顾了他领导必应与微软亚洲研究院的经历。

title.en: From Eliza to XiaoIce: Challenges and Opportunities with Social Chatbots
title.zh: From Eliza to XiaoIce: Challenges and Opportunities with Social Chatbots

note.en: A position paper tracing social chatbots from Eliza to XiaoIce and setting out the research agenda he saw for conversational AI.
note.zh: 一篇立场论文，梳理社交聊天机器人从 Eliza 到小冰的发展脉络，提出他对对话式 AI 的研究议程。

title.en: Real-time Lip Synchronization Based on Hidden Markov Models
title.zh: Real-time Lip Synchronization Based on Hidden Markov Models

note.en: Shum co-authored a paper on real-time lip synchronization using hidden Markov models, part of his earlier computer graphics research.
note.zh: 沈向洋合著了一篇关于基于隐马尔可夫模型的实时唇形同步的论文，属于他早期的计算机图形学研究成果。

title.en: Realistic, Real–Time Rendering of Ocean Waves
title.zh: Realistic, Real–Time Rendering of Ocean Waves

note.en: Shum co-authored a paper on realistic real-time rendering of ocean waves, from his graphics research at Microsoft Research.
note.zh: 沈向洋合著了一篇关于海浪真实感实时渲染的论文，出自他在微软研究院的图形学研究。

title.en: Bing, the fastest growing image search engine
title.zh: Bing, the fastest growing image search engine

note.en: Shum co-authored a paper on Bing's rapid growth as an image search engine during his tenure leading Microsoft's search business.
note.zh: 沈向洋合著了一篇论文，介绍必应图像搜索在他领导微软搜索业务期间的快速增长。

title.en: Bing dialog model
title.zh: Bing dialog model

note.en: Shum co-authored a paper describing Bing's dialog model for conversational search.
note.zh: 沈向洋合著了一篇论文，介绍必应用于对话式搜索的对话模型。

title.en: Technical perspectiveCustomizing media to displays
title.zh: Technical perspectiveCustomizing media to displays

note.en: Shum wrote a technical perspective in Communications of the ACM on adapting media content to different displays.
note.zh: 沈向洋在《ACM通讯》上撰写了一篇技术评论，探讨如何让媒体内容适配不同显示设备。

title.en: 07171 Summary – Visual Computing – Convergence of Computer Graphics and Computer Vision
title.zh: 07171 Summary – Visual Computing – Convergence of Computer Graphics and Computer Vision

note.en: Shum co-authored the summary report of a Dagstuhl seminar on the convergence of computer graphics and computer vision.
note.zh: 沈向洋合著了Dagstuhl研讨会关于计算机图形学与计算机视觉融合议题的总结报告。

title.en: 07171 Abstracts Collection – Visual Computing – Convergence of Computer Graphics and Computer Vision
title.zh: 07171 Abstracts Collection – Visual Computing – Convergence of Computer Graphics and Computer Vision

note.en: Shum contributed to the abstracts collection from the same Dagstuhl seminar on visual computing.
note.zh: 沈向洋参与了同一场Dagstuhl视觉计算研讨会的摘要合集。

title.en: Modeling and Rendering Heterogeneous Translucent Materials using Diffusion Equation
title.zh: Modeling and Rendering Heterogeneous Translucent Materials using Diffusion Equation

note.en: Shum co-authored a paper on modeling and rendering heterogeneous translucent materials using a diffusion equation approach.
note.zh: 沈向洋合著了一篇论文，提出基于扩散方程的异质半透明材质建模与渲染方法。

title.en: Blurred/No-Blurred Image Alignment using Kernel Sparseness Prior
title.zh: Blurred/No-Blurred Image Alignment using Kernel Sparseness Prior

note.en: Shum co-authored a paper on aligning blurred and sharp images using a kernel sparseness prior.
note.zh: 沈向洋合著了一篇论文，利用核稀疏先验实现模糊与清晰图像的对齐。

title.en: Human Intention Modeling and Interactive Computer Vision
title.zh: Human Intention Modeling and Interactive Computer Vision

note.en: Shum co-authored a paper on modeling human intention for interactive computer vision systems.
note.zh: 沈向洋合著了一篇论文，研究面向交互式计算机视觉系统的人类意图建模。

title.en: Reappointed HKUST Council Chairman for a three-year term
title.zh: 连任香港科技大学校董会主席，任期三年

title.en: 沈向洋教授续任港科大校董会主席– 香港科技大学（广州）
title.zh: 沈向洋教授续任港科大校董会主席– 香港科技大学（广州）

body.en: Shum was reappointed Chairman of HKUST's Council, continuing to lead governance at the university he helped build into an AI powerhouse.
body.zh: 沈向洋获续任香港科技大学校董会主席，继续执掌这所他曾助力打造为AI重镇的高校的治理工作。

title.en: Reappointment of Prof. Harry SHUM as HKUST Council Chairman
title.zh: Reappointment of Prof. Harry SHUM as HKUST Council Chairman

body.en: Shum was reappointed Chairman of HKUST(GZ)'s Council.
body.zh: 沈向洋获续任香港科技大学（广州）校董会主席。
